title: The Growth Kinetic and Ultra High Hardness of CoCrFeNiTi High–Entropy Alloy by Mechanical Alloying and Spark Plasma Sintering

recollection.starting_material: Guess: Co, Cr, Fe, Ni, Ti metal powders
recollection.intervention: Guess: Mechanical alloying and spark plasma sintering
recollection.structure: Guess: High-entropy alloy with a potentially homogeneous structure
recollection.mechanism: Guess: Mechanical alloying to mix and alloy the elements, followed by spark plasma sintering to consolidate and densify the alloy
recollection.results: Guess: Ultra-high hardness, possibly due to the formation of a high-entropy alloy with a unique microstructure

score.note: The recollection identifies only the title-level processing methods and gives generic descriptions of alloying, consolidation, densification, and a homogeneous HEA structure. It omits the milling duration and atmosphere, SPS temperature/time and vacuum, nanocrystalline grain size, 83% FCC/17% BCC phase mixture, detailed strengthening mechanisms, and all numerical mechanical-property results.
